events.title: Supreme Court releases opinion in Chiles v. Salazar (24-539)
events.summary: The Supreme Court released an official slip opinion in Chiles v. Salazar. Docket number(s): 24-539.
events.why_relevant: The Supreme Court's official opinion in Chiles v. Salazar is a primary legal source. Supreme Court opinions can define binding national law and alter the legal position of the executive branch, federal agencies, states, litigants, and democratic institutions.
